snippet.title: Scent of Ashes - Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
https://www.moddb.com/mods/scent-of-ashes

Scent of Ashes is a HL2 beta mod that authentically restores the atmosphere, graphics, and gameplay of Half-Life 2 during it's mid-2000 era of development. Experience the Source engine in it's primitive form as you play through development history and fight in the streets of City 17.

Nope, this isn't Goldsource. The core goal for Scent of Ashes is to revert the polishing of the final game to bring back the feel of the very early Source engine. Everything has been designed with absolute authenticity in mind while also providing a fun gameplay experience unlike anything you see in the final version of Half-Life 2.
